items.name: Proclamation further modifying scope of Canadian products subject to additional (Section 338) duties
items.changes: Adds and removes products from the list of Canadian goods subject to the extra 50% duty.
items.affects: US importers of Canadian valves, carpets, waste products, plywood, paper and machinery.

items.name: Exchange pre-eligibility verification (Working Families Tax Cut Act implementation)
items.changes: Exchanges must verify eligibility before enrollment, and premium tax credits and cost-sharing reductions are generally withheld while data matches are unresolved.

items.name: Draft guidance: Action Levels for Cadmium in Processed Food Intended for Babies and Young Children
items.changes: Sets recommended maximum cadmium levels in baby and toddler foods.

items.name: Adjusting Imports of Wind Turbines and Their Parts and Components (Section 232)
items.changes: Section 232 import adjustment (tariffs) on wind turbines and parts; details not verified.
